messages:
Maya (sec-eng): Kickoff: arranging a focused retest dry run for RBAC tweaks + KMS proxy work. Objective: produce a single, audit-ready evidence bundle for the assessor.
Leo (infra): Which environments? staging and a short preprod canary?
Maya (sec-eng): staging primary, tiny preprod canary for rollout verification. No prod.
Ivy (platform): We'll gate the RBAC change behind a feature flag and do a 5-min canary. Terraform toggle will be used.
Casey (oncall): Preferred window: Mon 03:00-06:00 UTC. I'll staff the bridge. Rollback criteria: >5% errors or median latency up by >20%.
Ruth (compliance): Evidence list: CloudTrail (AssumeRole), KMS access logs (Encrypt/Decrypt), STS token metadata, and S3 bundle with checksums + manifest. Manifest should list exact queries used.
Leo (infra): Sample KMS Logs Insights:
```
fields @timestamp, message
| filter message like /Encrypt|Decrypt/ and message like /alias\/redwood-staging-kms/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100
```
Leo (infra): CloudTrail sample:
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=AssumeRole --start-time 2026-05-01T02:00:00Z --end-time 2026-05-01T04:00:00Z
```
Maya (sec-eng): We'll tag ephemeral sessions with run-id: penrun-4967001111 so filters are precise.
Ivy (platform): Terraform snippet (feature flag):
```
variable "rbac_retest_enabled" { default = false }
resource "null_resource" "gate" { count = var.rbac_retest_enabled ? 1 : 0 }
```
Casey (oncall): I'll execute 60 synthetic /v1/infer requests and collect per-request token timings. If thresholds exceeded I'll flip the flag and revoke sessions.
Leo (infra): infra-bot: scheduled-job created: rbac-kms-retest 2026-05-04T03:15:00Z -> 2026-05-04T04:45:00Z (staging,preprod-canary). JobID: rj-496700
infra-bot: retention override applied: staging CloudTrail -> 120 days for run window.
Ruth (compliance): Evidence upload path: s3://redwood-evidence/retests/4967001111/. Include manifest.json, checksums.sha256, and explainer.txt. PGP-sign manifest if possible.
Maya (sec-eng): Post-run tasks: export CloudTrail slice, snapshot KMS proxy logs, export IAM session table, assemble zip, compute SHA256, upload. We'll document exact commands in the runbook.
Ivy (platform): Note: do not rotate production aliases. Use alias/staging-temp.
Casey (oncall): Bridge link: https://call.redwood.ai/bridge/4967001111. I'll join 10m early.
Ruth (compliance): I'll review artifacts within 48 hours. If anything missing, request narrow rerun for only that artifact.
Maya (sec-eng): Thanks. I'll publish the pre-run checklist and ping the group 24h before.
